column1: #mapping_set_title: LZZT endpoint -> objective (instrument named in a criteria sentence -> the objective that prints it)

#mapping_set_description: Keyed by the d2d transcripts of the CDISC Pilot protocol (tests/lzzt-layer1, tests/lzzt-endpoints). Objects and labels as in NCI EVS DDF Terminology 2026-09-25 (CDISC Submission Value).

column3: The ADAS-Cog (11) and the video-referenced CIBIC+ will serve as the primary efficacy instruments.
column6: To determine if there is a statistically significant relationship (overall Type 1 error rate, α=.05) between the change in both ADAS-Cog (see Attachment LZZT.2) and CIBIC+ (see Attachment LZZT.3) scores, and drug dose (0, 50 cm2 [54 mg], and 75 cm2 [81 mg]).
column11: The objective names ADAS-Cog (no item count); the criteria sentence names ADAS-Cog (11) as primary instrument.
